newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks dip in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks dip in moderate trade.

text.p: Most Croatian stocks dipped in slightly more active trade on Wednesday.
* Two of 11 issues that traded rose, six fell and three were flat.
* Volume was slightly higher at 7,002 shares, turnover almost doubled to four million kuna.
* Bigger of the two only gainers, hotelier Suncani Hvar, edged up two kuna to 67 on volume of 190 shares.
* Top decliner Trgovacka Banka lost 370 kuna to 1,250, trading 50 units.
* Most active food processor Podravka inched down three kuna to 312, with 2,013 shares sold. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
